run_eval_trigger_evaluation: run trigger evaluation for a skill description against a set of queries using claude -p
test_run_single_query: test a single query to check whether a skill description triggers the Skill or Read tool
run_eval_parallel: run parallel trigger evaluation across multiple queries with configurable workers and timeout
summarize_run_eval_results: summarize trigger evaluation results with pass/fail rates and per-query trigger statistics
test_find_project_root: test finding the project root by walking up from cwd to locate the .claude directory
